benchmark.pair_schedule: one frozen 12000-pair list, consumed unchanged by every engine except COLMAP 3.9.1 which also used the same frozen list
benchmark.host: Windows 11, GTX 1660 Ti (CUDA 12.8), 8 threads for COLMAP phases

visloc_rs_matrix_free.config: benchmarks/electro/visloc_1200_v1.json with the default BA schedule and --matrix-free-ba
visloc_rs_matrix_free.note: The dense/sparse Schur path did not finish in >5 h on this input; the matrix-free backend was required to complete it.

notes: COLMAP feature wall is the sum of the four per-camera extractions.
The visloc end-to-end reference is matching 498 s + mapping 1193 s ~= 1691 s; COLMAP 4.1 CUDA end-to-end is 31.71 + 51.29 + 6175.12 ~= 6258 s.
External dataset and generated artifacts are not stored in the repository; only this ledger and the configs are tracked.
The post-mapping scorer (scripts/score_electro_model.py) is the only consumer of the official reference poses.
